cursorLookup.matchesPerVariant: one per project variant (Domain net10.0 / netstandard2.0)

unitTests.store: cursor offset resolves to the declared type; outside a declaration nothing is returned; declaration index/file mismatch is rejected; evidence found by opaque id
unitTests.protocol: reveal maps to a selection with the requested scope; malformed reveal is ignored or repaired

conclusions.noNameBasedBinding: Type resolution reads declaration spans in the file; names are never matched, so a same-named type in another project cannot be selected.
conclusions.noStaleJump: Before revealing, the file's SHA-256 is compared with the analysed hash; a mismatch asks for confirmation, and an unsaved buffer is reported.
conclusions.readOnlyGenerated: Generated documents open through the sharpdeps-generated provider; nothing is written to the repository.
conclusions.noReanalysis: Reveal and location opening read the registered result only (zero analyze requests).
